flows.narrative: Investors piled into cash at a historic pace heading into the Oct 14 CPI print -- a record $166.4B flowed into money-market funds (largest weekly intake since April 2020) -- while global bond (+$33.8B) and equity (+$12.4B) inflows stayed comparatively modest and gold took in a further $2.0B. Within the US mutual-fund channel specifically (ICI data, same week), investors actually pulled $30.9B from domestic equity funds and $5.5B from municipal bonds -- a more explicitly risk-off skew than the broader EPFR 'flood into cash' framing alone suggests. This entire window predates both the Oct 14 CPI shock and the Oct 15 gold/silver/miners rally; the next edition (due ~Oct 16-17) will be the first to capture either.
